text:
Sam: Kicking off POC prompt-baseline work for NovaRetail. Need a tight prompt inventory, baseline prompts, eval plan, and timeline. Primary use cases: invoice extraction, agent-assist for CS, and personalized promo text. Goal: measurable CS handle time reduction (target 30%) and maintain quality. Can we scope what 'done' looks like?

Anya: I'll own prompt curation. Proposal for baseline prompts + quick examples below. We should keep prompts small and deterministic for extraction tasks, more open for summarization.

Anya: Example extraction prompt (baseline):
```
System: You are an assistant that extracts structured fields from receipts/invoices.
User: Extract vendor, invoice_date, total_amount, currency, and line_items from the text below. Return JSON only.
<INVOICE_TEXT>
```

Anya: For summary prompts: keep user instruction + max tokens + temperature=0.2. We'll version prompts like `v1-extract`, `v1-summarize`.

Diego: Quick commercial check — ballpark pricing sensitivity: if NovaRetail expects 100k calls/day, avg 80 tokens response, should we recommend Hosted for fast start or Dedicated for predictable unit cost? Also they asked about SOC2 and SSO in sec questionnaire.

Maya: From CS perspective: success criteria we need for acceptance:
- Extraction exact-match >= 95% for vendor and total_amount on golden set
- Line item recall >= 90%
- Summary ROUGE-L / EM target >= 0.88 (manual spot-checks)
- Latency p95 < 300ms on hosted, < 200ms on Dedicated
- Stability: <1% error rate over 24h
Please confirm sample size for golden set (I propose 1k diverse invoices + 200 customer conversations).

Evan: Suggest rollout and model policies: start with a smaller quantized model for cheap extraction (canary) and fall back to a larger full-precision variant if confidence < 0.7. Use prefix KV cache for repeated invoice formats. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on QA/regression alerts. Also add prompt-level guardrails (strip PII, redact SSNs).

Anya: For the eval harness, plan:
- Golden sets per use case (invoice, CS, promo) with labelled fields
- Automated checks (exact-match, F1, BLEU for text generation) + human spot checks weekly
- Sampling strategy: stratify by template, language, and anomaly rows (handwritten, scanned OCR noise).

Anya: Prompt metadata suggestion (tag each prompt):
```
name: v1-extract-invoice
intent: invoice-extraction
eval_set: invoices_v1
owner: @Anya
max_tokens: 256
temperature: 0.0
```

Diego: For the sec questionnaire: they need SOC2 + encryption at rest + customer-managed KMS for Private deployment. I've flagged Legal to prepare the response.

Deploy Bot: infra note: Dedicated reservation possible in us-west-2 (2 x A100) for a 3-week POC window. Hosted autoscale also fine for initial canary. We can pre-provision a canary pool on Mon.

Sam: Next steps / owners: Anya = prompt inventory + golden set; Diego = pricing quote + sec Q answers; Maya = success criteria and manual checks; Evan = rollout policy + fallbacks; Deploy Bot = infra reservation. Meeting Wed 09:00 PT to lock down golden set and timeline.

Sam: Link for artifacts: dropbox.com/s/novaretail/poc-artifacts (add golden set there). Please drop a quick note if timeline or success criteria need edits. :thumbsup:
